title: Move Actionbar
description: Remake of the Moveable Actionbar Mod By Burrnr but updated for 1.21.6+ and a few more features added.
body:
# Move Action Bar

Take control of your HUD. **Move Action Bar** lets you reposition and rotate Minecraft's action bar (the text that appears above your hotbar) anywhere on your screen.

This mod is a modern recreation of similar action bar positioning concepts, rebuilt and updated for newer Minecraft and Fabric versions with improved features and compatibility.

## Features

* **Drag & drop positioning** - Open the config screen and simply drag the action bar to your preferred spot.
* **Free rotation** - Rotate the action bar in 15° increments to any angle you like.
* **Multiline support** - Action bar messages containing line breaks are rendered cleanly across multiple centered lines (e.g. `/title @s actionbar "Test1\nTest2\nTest3"`).
* **Persistent config** - Your position and rotation are saved automatically and restored every time you launch the game.
* **Quick access** - Open the configuration screen instantly with a keybind (default: **Num Lock**, fully rebindable).
* **One-click reset** - Snap everything back to default whenever you want.

## How to Use

1. Press **Num Lock** (or your chosen keybind) to open the config screen.
2. Drag the "Action Bar" label to reposition it.
3. Use the rotate buttons to adjust the angle.
4. Hit **Done** - your settings save automatically.

## Compatibility

Client-side only - works on any server, no installation required on the server side. Built for Fabric.

---

*A lightweight, no-fuss mod for players who want their action bar exactly where they want it.*
